entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I need to return something. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and I just... I'm in a bit of a tough spot and was hoping you could help.
I can certainly look into that for you. I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. Can I start with your name and the order number?
Yes, it's Mark Solomon. The order number is VF789012. It's for a helmet.
Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up the order now. To make sure I'm assisting you correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, no, it's perfect. The box is still unopened. It was a gift for my nephew, but the color wasn't what he wanted, and I just... I feel terrible, but I really need the money back right now.
I understand completely. So just to confirm, there's no safety concern with the helmet or anything like that, it's simply a color preference. Let me just check the policy for you, one moment.
Okay, thank you. I'm really hoping you can help.

Alright, Mark, I've reviewed your order. I see the helmet was delivered 78 days ago. According to our policy here, you are well within the 90-day return window. So, yes, we can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh, thank goodness! Are you serious? That is such a huge relief. You have no idea.

I'm happy I could help. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file for you right now. Just print that out, attach it to the package, and drop it at any post office.
Wow. That's fantastic. This really helps me out a lot. Thank you so much, Diana.

You're very welcome, Mark. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. You've been a great help. Thanks again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
